verdicts.gapA: A shows none of the win criterion (no edit-and-return links, no tag explanations, no two-step delete), but its single biggest craft failure is the timeline region at the bottom: the blue compose FAB is painted over the post line "Pixelfeds Mastodon Api compatibility", clipping the end of the sentence, and directly above it the metadata table breaks a URL mid-string into "https://opencollective.com" / "/tusky" across two right-ragged lines while "source code & issues" wraps to two lines — the whole label/value grid is misaligned and unreadable at arm's length.
verdicts.gapB: The "Mes étiquettes" block states the rule "Le chiffre sur une étiquette : combien de bourses la demandent" and then breaks it: "Entrepreneuriat" and "Mobilité internationale" carry no number at all while Sport 2, Leadership 5, Bénévolat 5, Environnement 1 do — a missing count reads as missing data rather than zero, and the chips flow one or two per row leaving half the card width empty for ten rows, so the most information-dense section is also the loosest.
violationsA: Overlapping text: the compose FAB covers the end of the post line "Pixelfeds Mastodon Api compatibility" in the bottom timeline row
Broken/wrapped label-value pairs in the bio table: "https://opencollective.com" splits before "/tusky", "source code & issues" wraps mid-label
Displayed figures "2,880 Posts", "15 Follows", "21,000 Followers" sit with no source and no verification date, under a hedge that says the information "may reflect the user's profile incompletely"
violationsB: Header pill "TA COTE R 31,20" repeats the score with no source or verification date adjacent; the sourcing line "Confirmée par ton cégep, saisie par toi le 28 août 2026" only appears far below in the cheminement card
verdicts.notes: B is the only screen that answers the brief: "Modifier le cheminement" and "Modifier la cote" sit inside the rows they edit, the tags card says outright what tags buy you ("Sert à faire remonter des bourses auxquelles tu pourrais être admissible. Jamais partagé ni vendu."), and delete is fenced in a red card with consequences spelled out and an ellipsis button "Supprimer mon compte…" signalling a second step. Its weak points are copy and rhythm, not integrity — "2 sélectionnée(s)" is clumsy, "Préparer ma rencontre" never says what happens next, and "Modifier le cheminement" wraps to two lines inside its pill. A is a competent stock profile screen from a different problem, and it still ships an FAB parked on top of body text.

verdicts.gapA: Header pill "TA COTE R 31,20" displays a figure with no marker beside it; the qualifier that makes it honest — "Ta cote R est celle que tu as saisie" — is stranded in the footer disclaimer roughly 1,500px below, so at a glance the number reads as an app-computed score. Second-order: the guest card ("Enregistré sur cet appareil. Connecte-toi pour retrouver ces choix sur tes autres appareils.") uses the identical grey fill, radius and inset as the purely informational bell card above it, so the one card that carries an action ("Me connecter") is camouflaged as more boilerplate — two stacked prose blocks push the first toggle "Rappels d'échéances" below 700px.
verdicts.gapB: It is not a notifications screen and shows no guest/signed-in state at all: the list under "Appearance" is generic app chrome ("Theme / Selected: Light theme", "Dynamic colors", "Language / System default", "Show icons", "Code digit grouping"), so the guest explanation, the four explained notification toggles and the conditional push block are all simply absent. It also isn't a screen — the top ~25% is a store-listing headline ("Customizable / Many customization options, encryption and backups") wrapped around a device mockup, and the list is sliced mid-row at "Show the account name"; the non-toggle rows ("Theme", "Language", "Code digit grouping") carry no chevron or value control, so nothing signals they are tappable.
violationsA: Figure without adjacent provenance: the header pill "TA COTE R 31,20" shows a score with no source/entry marker next to it — the "celle que tu as saisie" statement lives only in the bottom-of-page footer, far outside the figure's reading context
violationsB: Truncated label: the bottom row "Show the account name" is sliced mid-row by the frame edge with its description cut away entirely
verdicts.notes: A is the only one of the two that is actually the screen in question: four toggles each with a plain-language consequence line ("jusqu'à 14 jours avant l'échéance", "Un rappel en fin de session (décembre et avril)"), an explicit device-local persistence line for guests, no orphan push block, and rows that are comfortably 44px+ with large clear switches. Its real weaknesses are hierarchy and rhythm, not substance — two near-identical grey prose cards delay the controls, and the four-row card floats in a large empty gap above the footer. B is a marketing asset of an unrelated Appearance screen; even judged purely as a screen it loses on affordance (value rows with no control) and on the clipped final row.
